extraction_notes: The supplied six-page PDF identifies ST3422A as an N-channel enhancement-mode MOSFET and carries the STANSON branding; the footer revision is STN3422A 2009. V1.

Transfer, on-region/output, on-resistance, body-diode, gate-charge, and capacitance-versus-VDS plots on pages 4-5 contain usable visible curves; points were manually digitized from the plotted traces without adding interpolated curve segments.

The electrical-characteristics table publishes minimum and maximum gate threshold voltage, typical and maximum RDS(on) rows, typical Ciss/Coss/Crss, minimum breakdown voltage, and maximum body-diode forward voltage. Both typical and maximum RDS(on) values are retained as separate points.
The table publishes no typical gate threshold value and no body-diode reverse-recovery trr value; threshold_typ is null and trr is outside this strict schema.
Capacitance table values are transcribed in farads from the stated pF values; plot points retain the plotted Ciss, Coss, and Crss traces and their VDS axis semantics.
omission_reason: No omission for the required MOSFET fields; threshold_typ is null because the datasheet provides only MIN and MAX, and body-diode reverse recovery is not published.
